newsitem.title: USA: UroQuest to submit catheter PMA in 2nd half of 97.
newsitem.headline: UroQuest to submit catheter PMA in 2nd half of 97.

text.p: Uroquest Medical Corp said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has confirmed that the company's Male and Female On-Command Catheters will be regulated through a premarket approval (PMA) process.
UroQuest said it expects to submit the application for the Male On-Command catheter in the second half of 1997.

It said the FDA has re-examined the Male On-Command Catheter IDE protocol being used in the company's ongoing randomized clinical trial and has indicated that the study design should be sufficient to support a PMA filing.
